title: FAR Module 4 · TBS 2
html:
TASK-BASED SIMULATION

Identify the Correct Fund

Analyze each independent scenario and enter the number corresponding to the appropriate fund type.

Fund Code

1 Enterprise Fund
2 Private-Purpose Trust Fund
3 General Fund
4 Internal Service Fund
5 Capital Projects Fund

Scenarios

Item 1

A city accounts for its normal administrative operations, police, and general public services.

Item 2

A county accumulates resources specifically to construct a new courthouse.

Item 3

A city-owned water utility provides water to residents and charges customers based on usage.

Item 4

A centralized vehicle maintenance department services vehicles used by other city departments.

Item 5

A government administers trust resources for specific private individuals rather than for its own programs or citizens generally.

Required

1. Normal Government Operations
2. New Courthouse Construction
3. Water Utility
4. Central Vehicle Maintenance
5. Trust for Private Individuals
explanation:
Item 1 — General Fund

The General Fund is generally the primary operating fund for normal governmental activities.

Correct Code = 3

Item 2 — Capital Projects Fund

Courthouse construction is generally accounted for in a Capital Projects Fund.

Correct Code = 5

Item 3 — Enterprise Fund

A water utility charging external customers is generally an Enterprise Fund activity.

Correct Code = 1

Item 4 — Internal Service Fund

A department primarily serving other departments of the same government is generally an Internal Service Fund.

Correct Code = 4

Item 5 — Private-Purpose Trust Fund

Trust resources benefiting specific private individuals are generally reported in a Private-Purpose Trust Fund.

Correct Code = 2

CPA Takeaway

  • General Fund → regular operations.
  • Capital Projects → capital outlays / construction.
  • Enterprise → external customers.
  • Internal Service → internal departments.
  • Private-Purpose Trust → specific outsiders.
